name: Child of Nature
summary: In Stormwind, Sheldras Moontree can show you the way to Moonglade. There, the Cenarion Circle’s druids have wisdom to share with a child of nature.

sections.title: A Far Stronghold
sections.body: Sheldras Moontree, a night elf in Stormwind, can show you how to reach Moonglade on Kalimdor. The Cenarion Circle keeps its stronghold there. It is an ancient order of naturalists and druids, with much to teach you.

faq.answer: Sheldras Moontree is a night elf in Stormwind who can show you how to reach Moonglade.
The Cenarion Circle is an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts.

faq.q: Where is the Cenarion Circle's stronghold?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle keeps its stronghold in Moonglade on Kalimdor.

faq.q: What can I learn from the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle’s druids have much wisdom to share with you.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you are among the first of your people to arrive in Azeroth, and you are welcomed.
As a druid, you are directed toward the Cenarion Circle, an ancient order whose members practice the druidic arts.

attribution: In-game quest text: Child of Nature
